scenes.title: The Sunny Meadow
scenes.body: Once there was a small brown rabbit who wanted to play in the sunny meadow across the stream. The only way over was a wobbly log bridge. A little green frog sat on a lily pad and watched. The rabbit looked at the log and felt a little scared.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about courage.

scenes.title: The Hopping Frog
scenes.body: The little green frog hopped onto the log and crossed it, one hop at a time. When it reached the meadow, it turned around with a happy croak. The rabbit thought, 'If that small frog can do it, I can try one little hop too.'
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about courage.

scenes.title: A Brave First Hop
scenes.body: The rabbit put both front paws on the log. The log wiggled a little. The rabbit took a deep breath, remembered the frog's little hops, and made one small hop onto the bridge. The frog croaked softly, as if to say, 'You can do it!'
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about courage.

scenes.title: Halfway Across
scenes.body: Halfway across, the log wobbled again. The rabbit looked down at the little waves and felt nervous. Then it looked ahead at the sunny meadow and the waiting frog, and kept going with one brave hop at a time.
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about courage.

scenes.title: The Sunny Meadow
scenes.body: With one last hop, the rabbit landed on the soft grass of the meadow. The little green frog jumped up and down with joy. The rabbit laughed and said, 'I did it! The wobbly log was scary, but I kept going.' And from that day on, the rabbit knew that courage is just taking one little step, even when you feel nervous.
scenes.altText: Scene 5 of a story about courage.
